Get Basketligaen Box Score

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_boxscore.Rd

Player box score and team rows of both sides (2023/24 on).

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/gameday/boxscore/{game_uuid}

Usage

sportality_boxscore(game_uuid)

Arguments

game_uuid

(required) Game uuid: gameInfo[].uuid of the schedule (10 lowercase letters and digits). Key space: platform game uuids; the Genius match id is extId / gameSourceId in the body.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player or team row, per side. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "sportality_boxscore")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportality_schedule().

See also

family_basketligaen lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(sportality_boxscore(game_uuid = "c4hh5nig6t"))
